title: A Specialized Semismooth Newton Method for Kernel-Based Optimal Transport
gist: Kernel-based optimal transport estimators are more statistically efficient than plug-in linear-programming estimators in high dimensions, but their reliance on the short-step interior-point method (SSIPM) makes them computationally intractable as sample size grows. The paper reformulates the problem as a nonsmooth fixed-point model solved by a specialized semismooth Newton (SSN) method with reduced per-iteration cost, proven convergence rates, and substantial speedups over SSIPM.
